itemText: Add a Chat action to the web review screen that opens the existing single-item card chat for the current card and returns to the same card when closed.
Add a Chat action to the iPhone and Mac review screens that opens the existing card chat for the current card, with a keyboard shortcut on Mac, and returns to the same card when closed.
Make a card chat started during review appear in the chat queue with the card it came from, so doubts raised mid-review can be picked up later.

After a chat about a card during review, the assistant proposes a fix for the doubtful card (replace it with a reworded card, edit it, or drop it) using the existing create-or-edit-from-chat suggestions, and the learner accepts or ignores it in one tap.
